title: Chapter 753 Changes In Times; Familiar!
content:
Chapter 753 Changes In Times; Familiar!

Chapter 753  Changes in Times; Familiar!

The current Earth was different from what Lin Fan remembered. There were many changes.

Skyscrapers that had a great visual impact, flying motorcycles that only existed in movies and cartoons, and all kinds of people who were surrounded by flames, ice armor, or wings... They walked freely on the streets.

This feeling was like coming to a game world.

Initially, Lin Fan was curious.

After some interaction, he finally knew…

It turned out that the current Earth was affected by spiritual energy and the fragments of the Great Dao, allowing many people to possess special abilities.

These people with special abilities were different from the rest and possessed great strength.

Gradually, it became a trend.

Therefore, those who had special abilities liked to display their special abilities on the surface of their bodies to show their strength.

As for those without special abilities, they bought decorations to achieve the effect of special abilities to satisfy their vanity.

Lin Fan couldn't help but sigh,'Times change too quickly.'

As Lin Fan walked, he tasted the delicacies of Earth and commented on them from time to time.

"The meat is soft, fat but not greasy."

"It melts in your mouth, leaving an endless aftertaste."

"Chewy, not bad!"

....

"Although people have changed a lot about fashion, their pursuit of food is still the same as before."

Lin Fan nodded his head in satisfaction.

When Lin Fan arrived before a hundred meter tall statue, he could not help but stop.

"Do you also want to obtain power from the Sovereign Lord?" The middle-aged man beside him asked."

"Sovereign Lord?"  Lin Fan was puzzled.

When the middle-aged man heard that, his expression became even more confused than Lin Fan's.

"You don't know Sovereign Lord?"

Lin Fan nodded.

The middle-aged man said,"It's rare for there to be people on Earth who don't know about the Sovereign Lord. Could it be…" Don't you watch the news?"

Lin Fan said," The place I'm staying at is special. There's no internet.""

Lin Fan was lying.

Coiling Dragon Villa had internet, and the signal was especially good.

However, he rarely used it.

When he was still an ordinary person, he liked to play games and watch anime…

However, after possessing a powerful cultivation base, these things were all less attractive to him.

After all, anime and games were just the imagination of ordinary people.

What Lin Fan had experienced and possessed far surpassed these fantasies. How could this be attractive to him?

"On a deserted island?" the middle-aged man asked curiously."

As he said this, he sized up Lin Fan again. However, he couldn't sense any aura of someone who had returned from the wilderness from him.

"Are there still undiscovered islands?"

In the past, there were indeed many deserted islands on Earth.

That was because these islands were located on the vast sea, and it was difficult for planes and ships to find and reach them.

However, with today's technology and many people with special abilities, was there still an island that had not been discovered?

The middle-aged man didn't probe further and continued,""The Sovereign Lord is the Lord of our Earth, Lord Lin Fan!"

When he said this, his face revealed an unconcealable look of admiration.

It was a kind of respect that came from the bottom of his heart.

" Lord Lin Fan has an omnipotent power. The reason why we are able to survive in this vast universe is all thanks to Lord Lin Fan. He is the savior of Earth!"

"You know what? According to incomplete statistics, Earth had encountered more than 10000 crises, including 7900 meteorite crises and 1200 alien attacks. As for other disasters on Earth, such as plagues, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and so on, there were countless of them!"

"If it wasn't for the Overlord, our Earth would have been destroyed countless times. In fact, everyone might have been captured and enslaved."

"The Overlord is the savior of our Earth!"

When the middle-aged man said this, he could not help but dance with excitement.

"In addition, many people who don't have special abilities or who only have very weak special abilities have the chance to obtain powerful special abilities bestowed by the Overlord as long as they believe in him!"

When Lin Fan heard this, his face turned weird.

He had indeed saved Earth a few times.

However, it was still far from ten thousand times, right?

And... When did he bestow any special abilities?

Then, Lin Fan thought of Little Rock, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann.

Could it be that when they recruited geniuses, they displayed some strength?

Then, it slowly spread like this?

The middle-aged man saw that Lin Fan seemed to have been influenced by his words and continued,""How is it? Isn't the Sovereign Lord great?"

Should he say that he was great?

How could he do that?

Lin Fan rubbed his nose.

" I don't know why," the middle-aged man said." I keep feeling that you look familiar. Have we met somewhere before?""

"Don't misunderstand. I didn't mean to get close to you."

"Young man, can you tell me your name? By the way, my name is Huang Tao."

"Lin Fan." Lin Fan said.

After he finished speaking, he stepped forward.

His speed seemed slow, but it was actually fast.

In a few breaths, it disappeared.

Only the middle-aged man was left muttering.

"Lin Fan? Why does this name sound like…"

In the next moment, he suddenly thought of something. He suddenly raised his head and looked at the statue that was more than a hundred meters tall in front of him. His eyes widened.

....

Lin Fan had lived alone on Earth for a few years. He was relaxed and contented. His entire heart had become abnormally calm.

In the beginning, he still had a playful attitude.

They just ate, drank, and enjoyed the scenery.

Gradually, he seemed to fuse with the ordinary people.

Or rather, he was just an ordinary person.

Lin Fan bought a house in the small town and even found a job. He worked at sunrise and rested at sunset.

It reached a state of integration between heaven and man.

However, he was still far from a breakthrough.

On this day, Lin Fan raised his head slowly and looked up at the endless starry sky.

He felt that if he wanted to break through, he would have to go out and take a look.

This was the intuition of a cultivator.

He began to recall the current defense of Earth. It had a defense that could withstand the attacks of 100 Sacred Lords for 1500 years.

Then, he calculated his own methods. He had equipment that could defend against the simultaneous attacks of 20 Sacred Lords, 10 ultra-long-distance teleportation talismans, and 10 pairs of Sacred Lord-level speed-increasing boots.

In this way, there was no need to worry about the safety of Earth.

As for him, even if he encountered a Sacred Lord, he should be able to protect himself if he was no match for him.

With these thoughts in mind, Lin Fan finally took a step forward and disappeared from the face of Earth like a beam of light.
